title: UI Frame Pipeline v2 Fearless Refactor
problem: Fret's current retained UiTree, declarative mounting, view-cache, paint-cache, and editor-specific hot paths are correct enough to optimize locally but do not yet form one direct, phase-attributable execution model. This lane owns the migration to explicit build/layout/prepaint/paint/render boundaries, complete old-path cleanup, and perf-gated editor-grade validation.

repro.summary: Start from the code-editor resize/paint path that already exposes layout containment and paint attribution pressure.
commands: cargo run -p fretboard-dev --release -- diag perf ui-code-editor-resize-probes --repeat 3 --warmup-frames 5 --reuse-launch --sort time --top 15 --json --perf-baseline docs/workstreams/perf-baselines/ui-code-editor-resize-probes.macos-m4.v2.json --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE=1 --env FRET_UI_GALLERY_VIEW_CACHE_SHELL=1 --env FRET_DIAG_SCRIPT_AUTO_DUMP=0 --env FRET_DIAG_SEMANTICS=0 --env FRET_CODE_EDITOR_DIAG_PAINT_PERF=1 --launch -- cargo run -p fret-ui-gallery --release --features gallery-full

continue_policy.notes: The ADR 0327 code-editor vertical slice is closed in CLOSEOUT_AUDIT_2026-05-14.md. M2 prepaint ownership includes a minimal ViewBoundaryState owner for typed prepaint outputs, diagnostics expose a top-level debug.boundaries[] list, M3 row-scene replay plans use ViewBoundaryState::scene_fragment via CanvasSceneFragment<RowSceneFragmentPayload>, M4A moved contained-relayout dirty reasons into ViewBoundaryState::dirty with a dirty_boundaries fast index, and M4B retired the nested debug.cache_roots[].boundary compatibility schema. The code-editor closeout perf run proves the selected paint-side bottleneck target. Continue this lane only for broader ADR 0327 follow-ons such as ADR review/acceptance, public boundary hint design, wider view-cache/paint-cache consolidation, and older env-knob ownership decisions.
